purpose: T051's registered mass-response curve (P3 capstone): dynamic removal cost vs NUMBER of anchor-band entries removed, random subsets k in {2..200}, 10 draws each, matched-stream continuations with clean-net final-64 tail judgment (the e085/e088 instrument; per-entry age-97-crossing V-zero schedule — e085's timing applied to sets, the registered adaptation documented in the file docstring). Threshold rise => mass-action; proportional rise => diffuse linear.

protocol.subset_rule: rng default_rng(89), k-major draw-minor order; rng.choice(band, size=k, replace=False); reject & redraw while min(cols) > 350 (full-tail exposure; rejections tallied)
protocol.run_rule: run = (k_index*10 + draw) % 8 — 10 draws per run overall, >= 1 draw of every k per run

timing.schedule: per-entry age-97-crossing V-zero: entry p zeroed immediately before the decode processing position p+97 (e085 timing VERBATIM applied to sets; the single-shot e088 variant is infeasible for k > 97 spread entries because later columns do not exist at T_int)
timing.t_int: min(S) + 97 (the earliest entry's crossing = the forced decode)
timing.unremovable: p = 414 crosses at 511, beyond the last decode (510): never zeroed, stays live, exposure 0 — tallied per draw
timing.e075_relation: k=200 arm = e075's A-self-prune at K=1 continuous schedule (e075 used K=32 events)

protocol.arms: 2 per group, SAME continuation seed (matched streams): control / crossing-time progressive removal of the subset
protocol.outcome: clean-judge tail CE (448..511) of removal stream minus matched control stream; per-k MEAN over 10 draws

bars.secondary: per-k SD/CV (mass-action predicts variance collapses past the break); per-draw cost vs min(S); first divergence

G3_protocol_identity_vs_e080.note: e089 has no static arm; G3 scope = control-battery identity (clean-judge per-seq vs e080 stored none arm) [e088's scoped G3 verbatim]

e075_reference.note: e075 A-self-prune whole-band cost, K=32 event schedule; e089 k=200 is the K=1 continuous analogue

registered_decision.verdict: Both threshold clauses fire: cost(k=32) = 0.034 of cost(k=200) (< 0.25) AND cost(k=128) = 3.35x cost(k=64) (> 3.0x). The curve is near-flat at small k and breaks sharply upward between k=64 and k=128 toward the k=200 level +2.153 (e075 whole-band reference +0.262 on its K=32 schedule). Removal cost is a function of MASS, not of any identifiable entries — P3's capstone: the anchor's dose-response law is threshold-shaped. Variance collapse: SD(128)/SD(8) = 1.78, SD(200)/SD(8) = 3.42.
